name: Vamsi Krishna Kocherla
subtitle: Robotics MS · ex-production CV scientist — perception that ships on edge hardware
status: building autonomous drones & SLAM systems at UMN
tagline: Cameras, LiDAR, and IMUs lie in their own ways. I get them to agree.
bio: Recovering ECE undergrad — started in signals and circuits, ended up shipping CV models for farm equipment: YOLO on Jetson, inference on Kubernetes, code that had to work outdoors in bad light. Now at UMN, going deeper on the parts that actually work: visual-inertial SLAM, Gaussian Splatting, and sim-in-the-loop autonomy.
focus: Fusing CLIP + DINOv2 into Gaussian splats for language-queryable 3D scenes
